included_history: Current results, recovery archives, and unique responses in job.tar.gz

pricing.assumption: All recorded input tokens priced as uncached; no cache-write surcharge.

limitations: No EXECUTION_PASS jobs: successful-run means are undefined, not zero.

scope.label_audit: No explicit Tool/Memory/Hallucination taxonomy fields found in scanned structured JSON; classifications below are retrospective and narrowly evidence based.

classification_definitions.Tool: Recorded model-service unavailability or EDA process failure; EDA table explicitly includes compilation validation failures. Preflight configuration/import errors are reported separately.
classification_definitions.Hallucination: Hallucination is operationally defined here as inventing references not present in the frozen authoritative mapping. One failed call counts once, not once per invented identifier.
classification_definitions.Memory: Not measurable from available labels/telemetry. Neither a zero failure count nor an inference from hardware memory text is justified.
classification_definitions.Unclassified: Evidence does not establish one of the three requested causal classes. The native diagnostic reason is retained.

failed_session_summary.coverage_limit: This denominator covers failed transcript sessions only. It excludes intermediate rejected candidates later corrected inside completed sessions, preflight probe failures, and EDA process failures; those are listed separately and must not be blindly summed.

diagnostic.message: r001 must replace exactly the commented Scenarios

The validated mappings define required stimulus and checking but provide no runtime api type, method/task signatures, transaction types, or observation/control operations. Because generated tests may use only the api object and may not access interfaces, environment, hierarchy, or configuration databases, executable UVM stimulus and checkers cannot be constructed without inventing an unavailable API contract.

The runtime public API exposes only reset, memory/CSR, boot, completion, interrupt, debug, and signature operations. It exposes no public operations or observations for top-level bundle presence/polarity, JTAG TCK/TMS/TDI/TDO behavior, AXI slave/master handshakes and fields, USER-channel absence, internal/external clock gating, stall/core-clock state, or execution PC. Therefore executable stimulus and a checker/oracle cannot be implemented for all mapped CHECKABLE testcases using only the declared public testcase boundary.
the single mapper correction must resolve to CHECKABLE

The complete available UVM context does not expose required stimulus/observation points for mapped CHECKABLE tests: no stall signal, external clock-gate control, raw/gated core-clock observation, or observable internal CSR clock-gate/reset effects exists in the supplied interfaces/classes. Additionally, CSR accesses are specified as offsets in a CSR region beginning at 0x30000, while the only supplied API hardcodes 0x0/0x4/0x8, leaving the executable external addresses ambiguous. Thus exact executable stimulus and oracle coverage for all mapped CHECKABLE testcases cannot be generated from the supplied context.
